name: Activity Timeline
description: Every URLQuery report on one UTC time axis, a lane per data source, the largest first, with lanes for the review-required and background-control reports, colored by confidence; a report opens in the side panel with its catalog and source rows and its link on urlquery.net.

records.name: report
records.one: one URLQuery report, by its report_id, gathered from every file that lists it

fields.name: source
fields.from: report-sources.csv data_source joined by report_id, and disposition
fields.how: a report with no source row takes Review required or Background control from its disposition

fields.name: catalog
fields.how: supplement when the report_id is listed there, else main

accepts.means: the report on line <n> of any of the three files, opened in the side panel with its other rows

units.means: one data source's reports, such as UNCTAD: Filter by narrowed to it
one UTC day's reports, the viewfinder on that day
the reports between two UTC times written YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, the viewfinder on that window
